title: Revision v3 successful classification batch
description: A complete successful prediction file is an array containing exactly id and predicted in every object. C-MAPSS has 60 rows and TEP has 70 rows. Labels below are the frozen valid_labels values for this revision; case is significant. This schema describes successful *_results.json files only. The semantically failed session has no repaired result file, and N/A is not a prediction label.
$comment: Ordinary JSON Schema cannot compare this array with the separate inference/batches.json sample list. It cannot enforce unique id values independently of other properties, or prove exact sample identity/order, prompt hashes, raw-response correspondence, tool absence, and prior freezing. uniqueItems rejects identical objects only. score_revision_v3.py performs these cross-file checks and is authoritative. For a future dataset, supply that dataset's frozen valid_labels enum rather than accepting the union of label vocabularies.

id.description: Exact lowercase eight-character hexadecimal ID from the frozen v3 input. Preserve leading zeros; do not coerce to an integer. Equality to the selected input row is checked separately.
